A shared platform

How ADD stays fair to every member
  1. 01

    Advisory Circle

    One member from each of the six pillars gives members a voice in programmes and keeps the pillars balanced.

  2. 02

    Every pillar on stage

    Every major ADD event features at least three pillars, so no single discipline takes over.

  3. 03

    Open about interests

    Where a founder's own firm is a member, we say so openly. ADD is a shared platform, not one company's vehicle.

  4. 04

    An annual report

    Each year we publish what ADD earned, what it spent and what it achieved for members.

Membership questions

Ask a question →
When does membership open?

Founding membership opens in January 2027. Founding members will be announced in Q1 2027.

How much does it cost?

Fees for each tier will be published before founding membership opens. Members who commit for 12 months in the founding year get a founding rate. Maker / Emerging fees are subsidised.

Does registering interest commit me to anything?

No. Registering commits you to nothing. We'll contact you before membership opens with fees, dates and next steps.

Who can join?

Architects, interior designers, fashion houses, furniture makers, artists and galleries, craft producers and creative media: anyone working across ADD's six pillars. There are tiers for established firms, practising studios, makers and graduates, and for clients and design lovers.

How many Founding Patrons will there be?

Founding Patron places are limited to 8–12 in year one.

Founding cohort

Be part of the first ADD cohort.

Register your interest and we'll contact you before founding membership opens, with fees, dates and what you could host.
